WPFToggleMaintenanceTasks.Description: On: create and verify IT-SHUTDOWN at 21:30 and IT-CLEAN at 12:30. Off: stop any running instance and delete both tasks. Installed files are retained.

WPFMaintenanceExportInventory.Description: Run the original GET-INFOMATION code now and verify C:\IT-MAINTENANCE\<computer>.csv and <computer>.txt. No account setup or restart is required.

WPFToggleMaintenanceMonitor.Description: On: install and verify IT-MAINTENANCE at 09:00 and 14:00 Monday-Friday. Off: stop any running instance and delete the task. Installed scripts and volume configuration are retained.

WPFToggleWindowsUpdate.Description: On: restore Windows Update defaults. Off: disable Windows Update. Restart Windows after changing this setting.

WPFMaintenanceTaskScheduler.Description: Open Windows Task Scheduler to inspect IT-SHUTDOWN, IT-CLEAN, IT-MAINTENANCE, and Windows Update tasks.
